pages.title: UI automation tests that locate elements by geometry: the five spatial selectors inside Terminator
pages.description: Most UI automation tests lock onto IDs, names, or XPaths that shift the moment the layout changes. Terminator ships five spatial selectors (rightof:, leftof:, above:, below:, near:) that find an element by its position relative to a visible anchor. Near uses a hard-coded 50.0 pixel Euclidean radius.
